# Bouncer

## Docs

- [Bouncer](https://docs.usebouncer.com/introduction.md): Bouncer Email Verification API lets you validate email address and verify its deliverability, in the way you want.
- [Integration Guidelines](https://docs.usebouncer.com/integration-guidelines.md)
- [Check available credits](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/credits/credits.md): Retrieve available credits.
- [Verify email](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/real-time/verify-email.md): Verifies single email in real-time synchronous manner.
- [Create batch request](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/batch/batch-create.md): Verifies one or multiple emails in a batch, offline manner.
- [Check status](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/batch/batch-status.md): Retrieve status of your request based on request id.
- [Delete request](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/batch/batch-delete.md): Delete emails associated with request. Results will be lost.
- [Finish](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/batch/batch-finish.md): This endpoint will trigger internal job which will finish processing and return credits for remaining not verified emails.
- [Get results](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/batch/batch-results.md): Download batch result as JSON. You can filter out what to download by status, eg. download only deliverable emails.
- [Process with email verification queue](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/batch-sync/batch-sync.md): Synchronous Batch Email Verification API verifies one or multiple emails in a batch, offline manner.
- [Create toxicity list job](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/toxicity/toxicity-create.md)
- [Check toxicity list job status](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/toxicity/toxicity-status.md)
- [Delete toxicity list job](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/toxicity/toxicity-delete.md)
- [Download toxicity list results](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/toxicity/toxicity-results.md)
- [Verify domain](https://docs.usebouncer.com/api-reference/domain/verify-domain.md): Verifies single domain.
